Service level is predicted at 98.1% for 17:00–19:00, well above the 80% target.","why":"The surge came from the login outage (INC-20261015-6270). Login_issue calls ran at 237 against 59.2 expected, and service level on general dropped as low as 12.2%. For the disruption window from 17:00 to 19:00, current staffing is predicted to deliver 98.1% overall, with 97.5% on payments and 98.9% on general. Abandons are predicted at 0.7%, the extra cost is ₹0 and there are no policy breaches. Rest of day is predicted at 95.6%. The payments shortfall (32 agents vs 38 planned) looks like a deliberate move of agents to general (40 vs 34) rather than absence, and payments is still predicted to hold at 97.5%.","trade_offs":["P1 adds an IVR callback on general from 17:00 to 18:00 at no extra cost. It gives identical predicted results (98.1%, 0.7% abandons), so it adds complexity without measurable benefit.","Leaving agents on general keeps payments 6 below plan. It is predicted to stay at 97.5%, so the risk to that queue looks low."],"watch":"Watch the status of INC-20261015-6270 and the login_issue call volume. If the fix slips or calls rise again, general could degrade quickly, and the IVR callback in P1 is a ready, free fallback. Once the outage clears, consider moving agents back to payments."}
